title: zero-native: a Zig desktop shell that gives your web app direct access to platform SDKs
description:
Electron ships an entire Chromium instance just to render your UI. Zero-native from Vercel Labs is a desktop shell written in Zig that calls C directly, giving your frontend pure access to platform SDKs with zero glue code. Use the native OS WebView for a tiny binary, or bundle CEF Chromium when you need pixel-perfect consistency. Auto-scaffolds Next.js, React, Svelte, or Vite with native build paths for macOS, Linux, and Windows. Web tech desktop apps without the Chromium tax.

https://github.com/vercel-labs/zero-native
